source.title: The puzzle of global Double Field Theory: open problems and the case for a Higher Kaluza-Klein perspective

accepted.question_text: Can the pre-NQP-manifold approach to Double Field Theory be extended from the currently constructed global examples to general T-dualizable backgrounds, in a way that produces a globally defined pre-NQP manifold for non-trivially fibered spacetimes without having to assume the T-duality correspondence space in advance or duplicate topological data between a gerbe and its dual?

evidence.quote: However there are still some open problems. The only non-trivial global case that was constructed in this framework was, as we saw, on the correspondence space M ×M0 M̃ equipped with the pullback of both the gerbe G and its dual G̃. But, for this construction, the correspondence space of the T-duality is not derived from the pre-NQP manifold theory, but it must be assumed and prepared by using the machinery of topological T-duality.

Moreover, in literature, a globally defined pre-NQP manifold for a non-trivially fibrated spacetime M was proposed only for the case of geometric T-duality. Recently [CWIKW19] applied pre-NQP geometry to the case of DFT on group manifolds. However the extension of this formalism to general T-dualizable backgrounds is not immediate.

accepted.question_text: Can Double Field Theory recover a general geometric string background, meaning a smooth spacetime manifold equipped with a non-trivial Kalb-Ramond field whose Dixmier-Douady class [H] is nonzero in H3(M, Z), rather than only the restricted cases in which the recovered gerbe is flat or torsion?

evidence.quote: Open problem. Therefore it does not seem possible to recover a general geometric string background made of a smooth manifold M equipped with a non-trivial Kalb-Ramond field [H] ∈ H3(M, Z). And, since DFT was introduced to extend supergravity, the impossibility of recovering supergravity poses a problem.

accepted.question_text: Can the Higher Kaluza-Klein framework developed here for global Double Field Theory be extended to the Heterotic DFT case?

evidence.quote: The cases of Heterotic DFT and Exceptional Field Theory will be explored in papers to come.

accepted.question_text: Can Exceptional Field Theory be formulated as a Higher Kaluza-Klein theory on the total space of the twisted M2/M5-brane bundle gerbe over 11-dimensional super-spacetime?

evidence.quote: We are intrigued by the prospect that Exceptional Field Theory could be formalized as a Higher Kaluza-Klein Theory on the total space of the (twisted) M2/M5-brane bundle gerbe on the 11d super-spacetime, such as the one described by [FSS18a].
